Rhea (AE): Heads-up team — LucidBridge wants a short POC to validate semantic QA + cost. They're proposing 2 weeks, EU-only, and asked for rough SLAs: p95 latency <= 350ms and Recall@10 >= 0.75 on their labeled set. Can we do a kickoff Fri 11:00 CET?
Omar (SE): Friday 11 works. Quick clarifying Qs: size of labeled eval set? expected steady qps and burst? and do they need SSO?
Rhea (AE): They said ~6k labeled QA pairs, steady 15qps, bursts to 60qps for <5min. SSO yes, SAML; they'll share IdP metadata.
Zoe (Eng): For infra I recommend start on hosted with autoscale policy, then Dedicated for final comparisons. Estimate: 1xA10G-equivalent for baseline, 2x for stable burst handling. We'll pin model to rwd-search-v3-quant for cost.
Anil (Security): I'll need their completed SSQ v3, a DFD, and confirmation of no regulated data (they claim none). Also DI: can we support KMS cross-account? Yes but need KMS ARNs.
Rita (CS): I'll own the invites and the demo sandbox. Can we provide a short demo URL for them to sanity-check results?
Omar (SE): Yes 2 I'll spin up a temporary demo with a small index and share API creds scoped to the LucidBridge trial project. Operational checklist: create trial project, model pin, enable prefix cache, set batch size 6, enable request tracing. I'll post CLI snippet in shared drive: ```
# trial project and key
redwood projects create --name lucidbridge-poc --region eu
redwood apikeys create --project lucidbridge-poc --scopes=generate,search
redwood models pin --project lucidbridge-poc --model rwd-search-v3-quant
```
Rhea (AE): Kickoff agenda (30m): 1) intros (5m) 2) goals & success criteria (10m) 3) security & data next steps (5m) 4) timeline & owners (5m) 5) open issues (5m). Agree?
Zoe (Eng): Agree. Let's capture measurable success criteria: a) p95 end-to-end <=350ms at 15qps b) Recall@10 >=0.75 on their eval c) cost per 10k queries <= target (we'll compute) d) integration checklist: SAML SSO, KMS access, EU residency verified.
Omar (SE): Prompt/eval example they sent: ```
System: You are a precise documentation assistant.
User: "How do I reset the sync token for account 42?"
Expected: steps 1-3, include CLI command, clever minimal text.
Evaluate: correctness score 0-1 (1=correct).
```
Anil (Security): I'll send the SSQ v3 and a short checklist. Need their DPA signed before we start Dedicated runs. If they insist on on-prem evaluation, that pushes ETA to 6-10 weeks.
Rita (CS): Pricing ask: they want committed vs burst and a blended estimate for the POC. I'll prepare a 2-sheet: hosted PAYG and Dedicated 3/6-month commit.
Rhea (AE): Blockers to surface: 1) legal/DPA timing 2) SSO IdP metadata 3) sample dataset delivery in CSV/JSONL.
Omar (SE): I'll prepare the eval harness and a baseline run by Day3. Zoe, can you estimate cost per 1k queries for rwd-search-v3-quant in eu?
Zoe (Eng): I'll run estimates and return numbers by EOD tomorrow. Also will include autoscale policy recommendation for 60qps bursts.
gcal-bot: Meeting created: "LucidBridge POC Kickoff" Fri 11:00 CET, 30m. Invitations sent.
Rhea (AE): Action items: Rhea 2 confirm legal timeline & collect IdP (due Tue). Omar 2 infra + eval harness + demo (due Wed). Anil 2 send SSQ + checklist (due Tue). Rita 2 pricing delta + invite roster (due EOD today). Zoe 2 cost estimates + autoscale plan (due tomorrow EOD).
Rita (CS): Thanks all 2 I'll attach the pricing sheet and invite names here shortly. :white_check_mark:
